crew.overview: Capturing John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and Ringo Starr in their electrifying element, 'A Hard Day's Night' is a wildly irreverent journey through this pastiche of a day in the life of The Beatles during 1964. The band have to use all their guile and wit to avoid the pursuing fans and press to reach their scheduled television performance, in spite of Paul's troublemaking grandfather and Ringo's arrest.
crew.title: A Hard Day's Night

crew.overview: London is terrorized by a vicious sex killer known as The Necktie Murderer. Following the brutal slaying of his ex-wife, down-on-his-luck Richard Blaney is suspected by the police of being the killer. He goes on the run, determined to prove his innocence.
crew.title: Frenzy

details.biography:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Diana Julie Harris (26 March 1921 – 30 May 2015) was an English costume designer. She won an Academy Award for her work in the film Darling (1965) and a BAFTA Award for her work in the film The Wrong Box (1966).
details.name: Julie Harris
